title: KatotohananQA: Evaluating Truthfulness of Large Language Models in Filipino
benchmark_measurement: Factual accuracy of LLMs on questions categorized under 'Religion' as part of a broader truthfulness evaluation.
findings: Large Language Models showed a significant performance drop on questions about religion when evaluated in Filipino (80.61% accuracy) compared to English (90.82% accuracy), a decrease of 10.21 percentage points. This indicates that truthfulness in the domain of religion is less robust when transferred to a lower-resource language.
